timeline.text: <@posthog> is there a difference in retention of users or orgs that are using insight or dashboard subscriptions. are they more likely to visit posthog or to create further insights or try other products

spans.value: 3× more often / ~11× the volume of insights

content.text: I looked at all orgs active on PostHog in *March 2026* (≥1 app pageview, ~118.7k orgs), split by whether they'd created an *insight or dashboard subscription* by then (2,162 orgs had; 116,527 hadn't), then measured their behaviour over the *following 8 weeks (Apr–May 2026)*. Unit = organization (

Metric                          No subscription (116.5k)   Has subscription (2.2k)
Came back at all                64%                        96%
Avg active weeks (of ~8)        2.9                        7.2
Created ≥1 new insight          20%                        67%
Avg insights created            4.7                        51.8
Distinct other products touched 0.6                        1.9
